paragraphs: I am a theoretical nuclear physicist and Lecturer in Physics at the University of Ghana. My research concerns the reaction mechanisms that form heavy and superheavy nuclei, studied with stochastic dynamics, uncertainty quantification and scientific computing.

cards.title: Education
bullets: **PhD, Theoretical Nuclear Physics**, University of Caen Normandy, France, 2021 to 2024.
**Joint Master's in Nuclear Physics** (Erasmus Mundus), Universities of Seville, Autonomous Madrid, Padua and Caen, 2018 to 2020.
**BSc Physics**, University of Ghana, Legon, 2012 to 2016.

cards.title: Appointments
bullets: **Lecturer**, Department of Physics, University of Ghana, from August 2026.
**Graduate Research Assistant**: Autonomous University of Madrid (2020), GANIL (2019 to 2020) and INFN Legnaro, Italy (2019).
